```{r}
#| label: setup-libraries-and-sources
#| output: false
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(gamlssTools)
library(ggpubr)
library(cowplot)
library(ggseg)
source("util_scripts/lmsz_functions.R")
source("util_scripts/utils.R")
# Code from https://github.com/brainchart/Lifespan/tree/main
source("../Lifespan/102.gamlss-recode.r")
source("../Lifespan/301.functions.r")
set.seed(2514)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: build-age-simulation-grids
#| output: false
# Construct equally spaced grid of ages and sex for centile-line calculation
sim_list <- list()
sim_list$Male <- expand.grid(AgeTransformed = seq(log(280),log(365.25*21+280),0.01),
                        sex = c("Male"))
sim_list$Female <- expand.grid(AgeTransformed = seq(log(280),log(365.25*21+280),0.01),
                        sex = c("Female"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load-chop-analysis-data
#| output: false
load('../data/analysis_prep_combined.RData')
slip_features <- read_csv("../data/CHOP/pheno_dict.csv", show_col_types = F)
```

```{r}
#| label: build-chop-22q11ds-dataframe
#| output: false
df_orig <- df

df <- bind_rows(df_orig, df.long) %>%
       filter(dx == "22q11DS", Source == "CHOP") %>%
       arrange(!is.na(main_analysis)) %>%
       mutate(across((contains("CT.") | contains("meanCT")), ~ ifelse(age_years < 2, NA, .x)),
              across((contains("CT.") | contains("meanCT"))
                     & contains("normalised"), ~ .x*10000)) %>%
       distinct(participant, AgeTransformed, sex, .keep_all = T)

# Add in longitudinal data for modeling (longitudinal data will be downweighted such that each subject has a total weight of one)
df.long$long <- TRUE
df <- left_join(df,df.long %>% select(participant, AgeTransformed, long)) %>%
          mutate(long = !is.na(long)) %>%
          filter(pathology == "Normal")

# Weight each observation by the inverse of the number of scans contributed by
# its participant, so that the participants with longitudinal 
# scans do not receive more influence on the fit than single-scan participants.
df <- df %>%
        add_count(participant) %>%
        mutate(weight = 1/n)
```

## Generate LMSz Growth Charts

```{r}
#| label: define-candidate-mu-sigma-models
#| output: false
# Candidate mu (m_models) and sigma (s_models) model sets, per manuscript
# Equations S1/S2: full age*sex interaction down to intercept-only/null. The
# best-fitting mu and sigma model (by BIC) are selected independently below.
m_models = c('~ AgeTransformed + sex + AgeTransformed*sex',
             '~ AgeTransformed + sex',
             '~ AgeTransformed',
             '~ sex',
             '~ 1',
             '~ 0')

s_models = c('~ AgeTransformed + sex',
             '~ AgeTransformed',
             '~ sex',
             '~ 0')

```

```{r}
#| label: fit-lmsz-models-per-phenotype
#| output: false
slip_worm_plots <- list()
models <- tibble(feature = features,
                 m_model = "",
                 s_model = "",
                 AIC = NA,
                 BIC = Inf,
                 age_coef = NA,
                 sex_coef = NA,
                 intercept_coef = NA,
                 interaction_coef = NA,
                 age_sigma_coef = NA,
                 sex_sigma_coef = NA,
                 intercept_sigma_coef = NA,
                 interaction_sigma_coef = NA)
library(gamlss)
# Build the growth chart model
p <- "zscore" # specify the phenotype
dir.create("../lmsz/lmsz_models_slip", recursive = T)
bc_dir = "../../22q_analysis_GM_revisions/braincharts_rac/gamlss"
for (pheno in features) {
  print(pheno)
  pheno_name <- glue("{pheno}Transformed.q.wre")
  zscore_name <- glue("{pheno}Transformed.q.zscore")
  old_pheno <- slip_features$old_pheno[slip_features$new_pheno == pheno]
  # Load SLIP fit model
  if (grepl("CT",pheno)) {
      orig_fit <- readRDS(glue("{bc_dir}/RDS/joint_mpr-{old_pheno}Transformed/FIT.EXTRACT.rds"))
  } else {
      orig_fit <- readRDS(glue("{bc_dir}/RDS/joint_median-{old_pheno}Transformed/FIT.EXTRACT.rds"))
  }
  
  # Make subset and zero-weight outliers
  # Zero-weight the following
    # > 21 years old
    # Not an A-D deletion
    # Gene z-score too extreme
  df_tmp <- df %>%
              select(participant, AgeTransformed, sex, weight, 
                     age_years, Deletion_Type,
                     !!pheno_name, !!zscore_name) %>%
              rename(pheno = !!pheno_name,
                     zscore = !!zscore_name) %>%
              na.omit()  %>%
              mutate(gene_z = scale(zscore)[,1],
                     weight = ifelse(age_years <= 21, weight, 0),
                     weight = ifelse(Deletion_Type == "A-D", weight, 0))
  
  # Loop through each mu and sigma model and find smallest BIC
  for (m in m_models) {
    for (s in s_models) {
      print(m)
      print(s)
      growthChartModel_all <- gamlss(formula = as.formula(glue("zscore {m}")),
                                     sigma.formula = as.formula(glue("zscore {s}")),
                                     family = NO,
                                     data = df_tmp,
                                     weights = df_tmp$weight,
                                     control = gamlss.control(n.cyc = 200),  # See (2)
                                     trace = F)
      # Iterative outlier exclusion: zero the weight of any observation whose
      # residual from the initial fit exceeds |3.5|, then refit below so the
      # final model/BIC are not driven by extreme outliers.
      df_tmp$weight_tmp <- df_tmp$weight
      df_tmp$weight_tmp[which(abs(resid(growthChartModel_all)) > 3.5)] <- 0

      growthChartModel <- gamlss(formula = as.formula(glue("zscore {m}")),
                                     sigma.formula = as.formula(glue("zscore {s}")),
                                     family = NO,
                                     data = df_tmp,
                                     weights = df_tmp$weight_tmp,
                                     control = gamlss.control(n.cyc = 200),  # See (2)
                                     trace = F)
      if (growthChartModel$sbc <= models$BIC[models$feature == pheno]) {
        fin_model <- growthChartModel
        models$m_model[models$feature == pheno] <- m
        models$s_model[models$feature == pheno] <- s
        models$BIC[models$feature == pheno] <- growthChartModel$sbc
      }
      print("--------------")
    }
  }

          
  print(pheno)
  
  # Collect model features
  models$m_model[models$feature == pheno] <- format(fin_model$mu.formula)
  models$s_model[models$feature == pheno] <- format(fin_model$sigma.formula)
  
  models[models$feature == pheno,"intercept_coef"]   <- fin_model$mu.coefficients["(Intercept)"]
  models[models$feature == pheno,"age_coef"]         <- fin_model$mu.coefficients["AgeTransformed"]
  models[models$feature == pheno,"sex_coef"]         <- fin_model$mu.coefficients["sexMale"]
  models[models$feature == pheno,"interaction_coef"] <- fin_model$mu.coefficients["AgeTransformed:sexMale"]
  
  models[models$feature == pheno,"intercept_sigma_coef"]   <- fin_model$sigma.coefficients["(Intercept)"]
  models[models$feature == pheno,"age_sigma_coef"]         <- fin_model$sigma.coefficients["AgeTransformed"]
  models[models$feature == pheno,"sex_sigma_coef"]         <- fin_model$sigma.coefficients["sexMale"]
  models[models$feature == pheno,"interaction_sigma_coef"] <- fin_model$sigma.coefficients["AgeTransformed:sexMale"]

  models$AIC[models$feature == pheno] <- fin_model$aic
  models$BIC[models$feature == pheno] <- fin_model$sbc
  
  saveRDS(fin_model,glue("../lmsz/lmsz_models_slip/SLIP_lmsz_{old_pheno}Transformed.rds"))

  # Update LMSz quantiles
  df_tmp <- df_tmp %>%
        add_column(!!glue("{pheno}Transformed.q.lmsz") := pred_og_centile_mod(fin_model,
                                                                          df_tmp)) %>%
        select(-c(pheno, zscore, gene_z, age_years, Deletion_Type, weight))
 
  df <- df %>% left_join(df_tmp, by = join_by(participant, sex, AgeTransformed))
  
  # Save worm plot
  slip_worm_plots[[pheno]] <- wp.taki(fin_model) +
                                  ggtitle("LMSz Worm Plot") +
                                  theme_pubr() +
                                  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
                                        axis.title = element_text(size = 12))

  
  print("-------------------------")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: save-chop-lmsz-data
#| output: false
write_csv(df,"../data/CHOP/CHOP_data_lmsz.csv")
```

## Generate Growth-Chart Curves

```{r}
#| label: generate-fans-all-phenotypes
#| output: false
for (pheno in features) {
  print(pheno)
  fans <-  backtransform_centile_fans(pheno, sim_list)
  if (pheno == features[1]) {
    out_fans_slip <- fans
  } else {
    out_fans_slip <- bind_rows(out_fans_slip, fans)
  }
}
df_slip <- df %>% filter(Deletion_Type == "A-D")
```

```{r}
#| label: exclude-outlier-superiorparietal-ct
#| output: false
# CT.rh_superiorparietal is an outlier exclude it
models[models$feature == "CT.rh_superiorparietal",c("AIC","BIC",colnames(models)[grepl("_coef",colnames(models))])] <- NA
```

# Generate Plots

## Rescale Curves to Native Units

```{r}
#| label: rescale-ct-and-etiv-fans
#| output: false
# CT scale is off and eTIV fans are doubled due to the structure of the SLIP models and input data. Manually correct
out_fans_slip <- out_fans_slip %>% 
                          mutate(SLIP_input_fans = ifelse(grepl("CT",pheno),
                                                          SLIP_input_fans*10000,
                                                          SLIP_input_fans),
                                 LMSz_fans = ifelse(grepl("CT",pheno),
                                                          LMSz_fans*10000,
                                                          LMSz_fans)) %>% 
                          mutate(SLIP_input_fans = ifelse(pheno == "eTIV",
                                                          SLIP_input_fans/2,
                                                          SLIP_input_fans),
                                 LMSz_fans = ifelse(pheno == "eTIV",
                                                          LMSz_fans/2,
                                                          LMSz_fans))
```

## Plot SLIP and LMSz Global Trajectories

```{r}
#| label: define-age-axis-breaks
#| output: false
x_breaks <- log(c(280, 365.25*2+280, 
                  365.25*6+280, 365.25*18+280))
x_labs <- c("0y","2y","6y","18y")
```

```{r, fig.height = 7.5, fig.width = 11}
#| label: build-slip-and-lmsz-trajectory-plots
#| output: false
slip_plots <- list()
lmsz_plots <- list()
mult <- 1
out_fans_plot <- out_fans_slip
for (pheno_of_int in c("eTIV","Ventricles","GMV","Cerebellum.all",
                       "sGMV","totalSA","WMV","meanCT")) {
  df_plot <- df_slip
  df_plot$pheno <- df_plot[[glue("{pheno_of_int}Transformed.normalised")]]
  df_plot$pheno[is.na(df_plot[[glue("{pheno_of_int}Transformed.q.lmsz")]])] <- NA
  if (grepl("SA",pheno_of_int)) {
    ylab_text <- bquote('Surface Area')
  } else if (grepl("CT",pheno_of_int)) {
    ylab_text <- bquote('Thickness')
    df_plot <- df_plot %>% filter(age_days >= 2*365.25+280) ### BRING FURTHER UP????
  } else {
    ylab_text <- bquote('Volume')
  }
  if(pheno_of_int == "totalSA") {
    pheno_label <- "Cortical Surface Area"
  } else if (pheno_of_int == "meanCT") {
    pheno_label <- "Mean Cortical Thickness"
  } else if (pheno_of_int == "eTIV") {
    pheno_label <- "Intracranial Volume"
  } else if (pheno_of_int == "Cerebellum.all") {
    pheno_label <- "Cerebellum"
  } else if (pheno_of_int == "GMV") {
    pheno_label <- "Gray Matter Volume"
  } else if (pheno_of_int == "sGMV") {
    pheno_label <- "Subcortical Gray Matter Volume"
  } else if (pheno_of_int == "WMV") {
    pheno_label <- "White Matter Volume"
  } else {
    pheno_label <- pheno_of_int
  }
  out_fans_plot <- out_fans_slip %>% 
                    filter(pheno == pheno_of_int,
                           !(centile_cat %in% c("cent_0.25", "cent_0.75"))) %>%
                    mutate(SLIP_input_fans = SLIP_input_fans*mult,
                           LMSz_fans = LMSz_fans*mult)
  # CT data is questionable at 0y. Limit to 2 years
  if (grepl("CT",pheno_of_int)) {
    df_plot <- df_plot %>% filter(age_days >= 2*365.25+280)
    out_fans_plot <- out_fans_plot %>% filter(AgeTransformed >= log(2*365.25+280))
  }
  print(pheno_of_int)
  
  # Plot the original SLIP fans with 22q data points
  slip_plots[[pheno_of_int]] <- ggplot(out_fans_plot) +
                                    geom_point(data = df_plot, aes(y = pheno,
                                               x = AgeTransformed, fill=sex), 
                                               alpha=0.5, shape=21, size = 0.5) +
                                    geom_line(aes(x = AgeTransformed, y = SLIP_input_fans,
                                                  group = interaction(centile_cat, sex),
                                                  color = sex,
                                                  linewidth = line_size,
                                                  linetype = line_type)) +
                                    scale_linewidth_identity() +
                                    scale_linetype_identity() +
                                    scale_colour_manual(values = c("firebrick","royalblue")) +
                                    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labs) +
                                    ggtitle(pheno_label) + theme_pubclean() +
                                    xlab("") + ylab(ylab_text) +
                                  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
                                        axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
                                        axis.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
                                  figure_theme
  
  # Plot the 22q-adjusted SLIP fans with 22q data points
  lmsz_plots[[pheno_of_int]] <- ggplot(out_fans_plot) +
                                    geom_point(data = df_plot, aes(y = pheno,
                                               x = AgeTransformed, fill=sex), 
                                               alpha=0.5, shape=21, size = 0.5) +
                                    geom_line(aes(x = AgeTransformed, y = LMSz_fans,
                                                  group = interaction(centile_cat, sex),
                                                  color = sex,
                                                  linewidth = line_size,
                                                  linetype = line_type)) +
                                    scale_linewidth_identity() +
                                    scale_linetype_identity() +
                                    scale_colour_manual(values = c("firebrick","royalblue")) +
                                    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labs) +
                                    theme_pubclean() +
                                    xlab("") + ylab(ylab_text) +
                                  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
                                        axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
                                        axis.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
                                  figure_theme
  
  # Equalize Axes
  p_y_min <- min(layer_scales(slip_plots[[pheno_of_int]])$y$range$range[1],
                 layer_scales(lmsz_plots[[pheno_of_int]])$y$range$range[1])
  p_y_max <- max(layer_scales(slip_plots[[pheno_of_int]])$y$range$range[2],
                 layer_scales(lmsz_plots[[pheno_of_int]])$y$range$range[2])

  slip_plots[[pheno_of_int]] <- slip_plots[[pheno_of_int]] + ylim(p_y_min,p_y_max)
  lmsz_plots[[pheno_of_int]] <- lmsz_plots[[pheno_of_int]] + ylim(p_y_min,p_y_max)
}
```

## Plot Overlaid Trajectories

```{r}
#| label: build-overlap-trajectory-plots
#| output: false

# Generate a plot that averages centile fans across sexes for easy comparison between 22q and SLIP
overlap_plots_deriv <- list()
out_fans_plot <- out_fans_slip
for (pheno_of_int in c("eTIV","Ventricles","GMV","Cerebellum.all",
                       "sGMV","totalSA","WMV","meanCT")) {
  df_plot <- df_slip
  df_plot$pheno <- df_plot[[glue("{pheno_of_int}Transformed.normalised")]]
  if (grepl("SA",pheno_of_int)) {
    ylab_text <- bquote('Surface Area')
    mult <- 1
  } else if (grepl("CT",pheno_of_int)) {
    ylab_text <- bquote('Thickness')
    mult <- 1
  } else {
    ylab_text <- bquote('Volume')
    mult <- 1
  }
  if (pheno_of_int == "eTIV") {
    pheno_renamed <- "Intracranial Volume"
  } else if (pheno_of_int == "Cerebellum.all") {
    pheno_renamed <- "Cerebellum"
  } else {
    pheno_renamed <- pheno_of_int
  }
  
  out_fans_plot <- out_fans_slip %>% 
                    filter(pheno == pheno_of_int,
                           !(centile_cat %in% c("cent_0.25", "cent_0.75"))) %>%
                    mutate(SLIP_input_fans = SLIP_input_fans*mult,
                           LMSz_fans = LMSz_fans*mult)
  if (grepl("CT",pheno_of_int)) {
    df_plot <- df_plot %>% filter(age_days >= 2*365.25+280)
    out_fans_plot <- out_fans_plot %>% filter(AgeTransformed >= log(2*365.25+280))
  }
  print(pheno_of_int)
  out_fans_plot_avg <-   out_fans_plot %>% 
                          filter(grepl(str_replace_all(pheno_of_int,"SA.","SA.*"),pheno),
                                 !(centile_cat %in% c("cent_0.25", "cent_0.75"))) %>%
                          mutate(SLIP_input_fans = SLIP_input_fans*mult,
                                 LMSz_fans = LMSz_fans*mult) %>%
                          group_by(model, AgeTransformed, 
                                   centile_cat, line_size, line_type) %>%
                          summarize(across(contains("fans"), ~mean(.x, na.rm = T))) %>%
                          ungroup() %>%
                          select(-c(line_size,line_type, LMSz_input_fans)) %>%
                          pivot_wider(names_from = "centile_cat", 
                                      values_from = c("LMSz_fans","SLIP_input_fans"))
  
  out_fans_plot <-   out_fans_plot %>% 
                          filter(grepl(str_replace_all(pheno_of_int,"SA.","SA.*"),pheno),
                                 !(centile_cat %in% c("cent_0.25", "cent_0.75"))) %>%
                          mutate(SLIP_input_fans = SLIP_input_fans*mult,
                                 LMSz_fans = LMSz_fans*mult) %>%
                          select(-c(line_size,line_type, LMSz_input_fans,
                                    LMSz_input_centile, pheno, site, fit_file)) %>%
                          pivot_wider(names_from = "centile_cat", 
                                      values_from = c("LMSz_fans","SLIP_input_fans"))
  
  overlap_plots_deriv[[pheno_of_int]] <- ggplot(out_fans_plot_avg, aes(x = AgeTransformed)) +
                  # 22q-Adjusted: ribbon (accent color)
                  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LMSz_fans_cent_0.025,
                                  ymax = LMSz_fans_cent_0.975,
                                  fill = "22q11DS (LMSz)"),
                              alpha = 0.25) +
                  # Reference: dashed CI bounds, no fill (black)
                  geom_line(aes(y = SLIP_input_fans_cent_0.025, color = "Reference (SLIP)"),
                            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
                  geom_line(aes(y = SLIP_input_fans_cent_0.975, color = "Reference (SLIP)"),
                            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
                  # central trend lines
                  geom_line(aes(y = SLIP_input_fans_cent_0.5, color = "Reference (SLIP)"),
                            linewidth = 1) +
                  geom_line(aes(y = LMSz_fans_cent_0.5, color = "22q11DS (LMSz)"), 
                            linewidth = 1) +
                  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labs, 
                                     expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
                  ggtitle(pheno_renamed) + theme_pubclean() +
                  xlab("") + ylab(ylab_text) + 
                  labs(colour = "Growth Chart", fill = "Growth Chart") +
                  scale_colour_manual(values = c("22q11DS (LMSz)" = "#D55E00", 
                                                 "Reference (SLIP)" = "black")) +
                  scale_fill_manual(values = c("22q11DS (LMSz)" = "#D55E00")) +
                  scale_linewidth_identity() +
                  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
                        axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
                        axis.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
                  guides(fill = "none") +
                          figure_theme
}
```

## Regional LMSz Coefficient Maps (Figure S10)

#### Mu

```{r, fig.height = 4.5, fig.width = 7.5}
#| label: plot-mu-regional-effects
#| fig-cap: "Regional age and sex coefficients from the mu (mean) component of the syndrome-specific LMSz models."

models$label <- models$feature

lim <- models %>% select(age_coef, sex_coef) %>% abs() %>% max(na.rm = T)
lim <- ceiling(lim*10)/10
plot_lims <- c(-lim,lim)

p_age_effects <- plot_extreme_deviation_maps(models, 
                           fill_col = "age_coef", 
                           color_scheme = c("royalblue","white","firebrick"),
                           plot_lims = plot_lims, fill_name = "",
                           colorbar_title = "Beta",
                           sig_col = NA, cats = c("GM", "SA","CT", "SUBC"),
                           cort_only = F, add_colorbar = F, add_fillbar = T,
                           exclude_y_label = F, formatted = T, percent = F)

p_sex_effects <- plot_extreme_deviation_maps(models, 
                           fill_col = "sex_coef", 
                           color_scheme = c("royalblue","white","firebrick"),
                           plot_lims = plot_lims, fill_name = "",
                           colorbar_title = "Beta",
                           sig_col = NA, cats = c("GM", "SA","CT", "SUBC"),
                           cort_only = F, add_colorbar = F, add_fillbar = T,
                           exclude_y_label = F, formatted = T, percent = F)

p_age_title <- ggdraw() + draw_label("Age", angle = 90,
                                  x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
p_sex_title <- ggdraw() + draw_label("Sex", angle = 90,
                                  x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")

p_age_effects <- ggarrange(p_age_title, p_age_effects,
                            nrow = 1, ncol = 2, widths = c(0.1,1.2),
                            legend = "bottom", common.legend = T)

p_sex_effects <- ggarrange(p_sex_title, p_sex_effects,
                            nrow = 1, ncol = 2, widths = c(0.1,1.2),
                            legend = "bottom", common.legend = T)

p_effects_mu <- ggarrange(p_age_effects, p_sex_effects, nrow = 2, ncol = 1,
                            heights = c(1,1), common.legend = T, legend = "bottom")
p_effects_mu
```

#### Sigma

```{r, fig.height = 4.5, fig.width = 8.5}
#| label: plot-sigma-regional-effects
#| fig-cap: "Regional age and sex coefficients from the sigma (variance) component of the syndrome-specific LMSz models."
models$label <- models$feature

lim <- models %>% select(age_sigma_coef, sex_sigma_coef) %>% abs() %>% max(na.rm = T)
lim <- ceiling(lim*10)/10

plot_lims <- c(-lim,lim)

p_age_effects <- plot_extreme_deviation_maps(models, 
                           fill_col = "age_sigma_coef", 
                           color_scheme = c("royalblue","white","firebrick"),
                           plot_lims = plot_lims, fill_name = "",
                           colorbar_title = "Beta",
                           sig_col = NA, cats = c("GM", "SA","CT", "SUBC"),
                           cort_only = F, add_colorbar = F, add_fillbar = T,
                           exclude_y_label = F, formatted = T, percent = F)

p_sex_effects <- plot_extreme_deviation_maps(models, 
                           fill_col = "sex_sigma_coef", 
                           color_scheme = c("royalblue","white","firebrick"),
                           plot_lims = plot_lims, fill_name = "",
                           colorbar_title = "Beta",
                           sig_col = NA, cats = c("GM", "SA","CT", "SUBC"),
                           cort_only = F, add_colorbar = F, add_fillbar = T,
                           exclude_y_label = F, formatted = T, percent = F)

p_age_title <- ggdraw() + draw_label("Age", angle = 90,
                                  x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
p_sex_title <- ggdraw() + draw_label("Sex", angle = 90,
                                  x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")

p_age_effects <- ggarrange(p_age_title, p_age_effects,
                            nrow = 1, ncol = 2, widths = c(0.1,1.2),
                            legend = "bottom", common.legend = T)

p_sex_effects <- ggarrange(p_sex_title, p_sex_effects,
                            nrow = 1, ncol = 2, widths = c(0.1,1.2),
                            legend = "bottom", common.legend = T)

p_effects_sigma <- ggarrange(p_age_effects, p_sex_effects, nrow = 2, ncol = 1,
                            heights = c(1,1), common.legend = T, legend = "bottom")

p_effects_sigma
```

## Assemble Figure 4

```{r, fig.height= 12, fig.width=8}
#| label: assemble-figure-4-panels
#| output: false
library(patchwork)
# 4 x 6 plot
  # 4 rows (IDPs)
  # 3 cols (orig, adjusted, overlaid)
  # repeat
# bottom row: exploratory{r, fig.height = 12, fig.width = 12}

leg1 <- get_legend(slip_plots$eTIV + labs(fill = "Sex", color = "Sex") + 
                      theme(legend.title = element_text(size = base_font - 1, 
                                                        margin = margin(r = 15)),
                            legend.spacing.x = unit(0.3, "cm"))) %>% 
                as_ggplot() + figure_theme
leg2 <- get_legend(overlap_plots_deriv$eTIV + 
                      theme(legend.title = element_text(size = base_font - 1, 
                                                        margin = margin(r = 15)),
                            legend.spacing.x = unit(0.3, "cm"))) %>% 
                as_ggplot() + figure_theme

plots_final <- list()
for (pheno_of_int in c("eTIV","GMV","sGMV","WMV",
                       "Ventricles","Cerebellum.all",
                       "totalSA","meanCT")) {
  if (pheno_of_int == "eTIV") {
    pheno_label <- "Intracranial Volume"
  } else if (pheno_of_int == "Cerebellum.all") {
    pheno_label <- "Cerebellum"
  } else if (pheno_of_int == "totalSA") {
    pheno_label <- "Cortical Surface Area"
  } else if (pheno_of_int == "meanCT") {
    pheno_label <- "Mean Cortical Thickness"
  } else if (pheno_of_int == "GMV") {
    pheno_label <- "Gray Matter Volume"
  } else if (pheno_of_int == "sGMV") {
    pheno_label <- "Subcortical Gray Matter Volume"
  } else if (pheno_of_int == "WMV") {
    pheno_label <- "White Matter Volume"
  } else {
    pheno_label <- pheno_of_int
  }

  plot_marg <- margin(t = 2, r = 3, b = 0, l = 2)

  p_ref <- slip_plots[[pheno_of_int]] + ggtitle("Reference") + 
              theme(legend.position = "none",
                  plot.title = element_text(margin = margin(t = 0, b = 2), vjust = 0),
                  plot.margin = plot_marg) +
               figure_theme
  
  y_scale <- layer_scales(p_ref)$y$range$range
  y_breaks <- ggplot_build(p_ref)$layout$panel_params[[1]]$y$breaks
  
  p_ref <- p_ref  +
               scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks, limits = y_scale) +
               figure_theme + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = base_font - 2.5))
  
  p_adj <- lmsz_plots[[pheno_of_int]] + ggtitle("22q11DS") + 
                theme(legend.position = "none",
                      plot.title = element_text(margin = margin(t = 0, b = 2), vjust = 0),
                      plot.margin = plot_marg) +
               scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks, limits = y_scale) +
               figure_theme + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = base_font - 2.5))
  
  p_ovr <- overlap_plots_deriv[[pheno_of_int]] + ggtitle("Overlap") +
                theme(legend.position = "none",
                      plot.title = element_text(margin = margin(t = 0, b = 2), vjust = 0),
                      plot.margin = plot_marg) + 
              scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks, limits = y_scale) +
              figure_theme + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = base_font - 2.5))
  
  p1 <- (p_ref | p_adj | p_ovr) + plot_layout(axes = "collect")

  p_title <- ggdraw() + draw_label(pheno_label, fontface = "bold",
                                   size = base_font + 1) + figure_theme
  plots_final[[pheno_of_int]] <- plot_grid(p_title, p1, nrow = 2, ncol = 1,
                                            rel_heights = c(0.07, 1))
}

p1A <- plot_grid(plotlist = plots_final[1:4], nrow = 4, ncol = 1)
p1B <- plot_grid(plotlist = plots_final[5:8], nrow = 4, ncol = 1)
p1  <- plot_grid(p1A, NULL, p1B, rel_widths = c(1, 0.01, 1), ncol = 3)
p2 <- plot_grid(NULL, leg1, leg2, NULL, nrow = 1, ncol = 4,
                 rel_widths = c(0.2, 1, 1, 0.2))
```

## Save LMSz Model Table (Table S11)

```{r}
#| label: save-formatted-lmsz-table
models_fmt <- models %>% select(-c(m_model, s_model)) %>%
                  mutate(label = case_match(feature,
                                            "Cerebellum.all" ~ "Cerebellum",
                                            "SUBC.Left_Accumbens.area" ~ "SUBC.Left_Accumbens",
                                            "SUBC.Right_Accumbens.area" ~ "SUBC.Right_Accumbens",
                                            .default = feature)) %>%
                  relocate(label, .before = feature) %>%
                  separate_wider_delim(label, delim = ".", names = c("IDP Group", "IDP"),
                                       too_few = "align_end") %>%
                  mutate(`IDP Group` = ifelse(is.na(`IDP Group`), "Global", `IDP Group`),
                         `IDP Group` = factor(`IDP Group`, levels = c("Global","SUBC","GM","SA","CT")),
                         across(contains("_coef"), ~ round(.x, 2)),
                         across(ends_with("IC"), ~ round(.x, 0))) %>%
                  select(-feature, contains("interaction")) %>%
                  arrange(`IDP Group`, IDP)
models_fmt
write_csv(models_fmt, "../tables/formatted/table_s11.csv")

```
